taskVersion.name: deadline-math-direct
taskVersion.description: Convert a published contest deadline to the reader's local time. Cases: day rollover, the weeks when the EU and US change clocks on different dates, 12 AM and AoE wording, non-hour offsets. Ground truth computed with zoneinfo.

parts.text:

When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

Spain (Madrid) is in the CET/CEST timezone. On October 30, 2026, daylight saving time in Europe ends on the last Sunday of October. In 2026, the last Sunday of October is October 25, so by October 30, Madrid will be on CET (UTC+1).

ET on October 30, 2026: The US DST ends on November 1, 2026 (first Sunday of November), so on October 30, ET is still EDT (UTC-4).

9:00 AM EDT = 13:00 UTC = 14:00 CET

ANSWER: 2026-10-30 14:00

When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to convert 12:00 AM ET on October 12, 2026 to Madrid time.

12:00 AM ET = midnight at the start of October 12, 2026.

October 12, 2026: Madrid is on CEST (Central European Summer Time) = UTC+2 (DST ends last Sunday of October, so still in effect on Oct 12).

ET in October: EDT (Eastern Daylight Time) = UTC-4.

Midnight EDT = 00:00 UTC-4 = 04:00 UTC = 06:00 UTC+2 (Madrid).

ANSWER: 2026-10-12 06:00

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Papers are due October 9, 2026 (23:59 AoE)."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

AoE (Anywhere on Earth) is UTC-12. Madrid in October is on CEST (Central European Summer Time), which is UTC+2. The difference is 14 hours ahead of AoE.

October 9, 2026 23:59 AoE = October 10, 2026 13:59 Madrid time.

ANSWER: 2026-10-10 13:59

When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to determine what IST means here and convert to Madrid time.

IST = Indian Standard Time = UTC+5:30

Madrid in November = CET = UTC+1

Difference: IST is 4 hours 30 minutes ahead of Madrid.

So 11:59 PM IST November 10 = 23:59 - 4:30 = 19:29 Madrid time on November 10.

ANSWER: 2026-11-10 19:29

I live in Lima, Peru. A contest page says: "Submissions close at 5:00 PM Nepal time on April 2, 2026."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

Nepal Time (NPT) is UTC+5:45. Lima, Peru is UTC-5.

The offset from Nepal to Lima is -10:45.

5:00 PM (17:00) NPT on April 2, 2026 → subtract 10 hours 45 minutes → 06:15 AM on April 2, 2026 Lima time.

ANSWER: 2026-04-02 06:15

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Applications close 10:00 AM Adelaide time, October 6, 2026."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to convert Adelaide time (ACST/ACDT) to Madrid time (CET/CEST) for October 6, 2026.

October 6, 2026: Australia is heading into spring/summer, so Adelaide will be on ACDT (Australian Central Daylight Time) = UTC+10:30.

October 6, 2026: Spain/Madrid is in CEST (Central European Summer Time) = UTC+2. (Spain switches back to CET at end of October, so October 6 is still CEST.)

Adelaide 10:00 AM ACDT = UTC+10:30 → UTC time = 10:00 - 10:30 = previous day 23:30 UTC (October 5, 2026 at 23:30 UTC).

Madrid CEST = UTC+2 → 23:30 UTC + 2:00 = October 6, 2026 at 01:30 local Madrid time.

ANSWER: 2026-10-06 01:30

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Entries close 6:00 PM Sydney time on October 3, 2026."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to find the time difference between Sydney and Madrid on October 3, 2026.

Sydney (AEDT) in October: Australia switches to Daylight Saving Time on the first Sunday of October. In 2026, October 4 is a Sunday, so on October 3, Sydney is still on AEST (UTC+10).

Madrid in October: Spain switches back to standard time on the last Sunday of October. So on October 3, 2026, Madrid is still on CEST (UTC+2).

Difference: Sydney UTC+10, Madrid UTC+2 → Madrid is 8 hours behind Sydney.

6:00 PM Sydney time = 18:00 AEST → 18:00 - 8:00 = 10:00 Madrid time, same day October 3, 2026.

ANSWER: 2026-10-03 10:00
